reason: I have never heard of PetMetro and my vet has never mentioned it, so I am not switching my cat off the food I already trust for a booth brand at RM 2.80 a pouch. I might follow the page and take the free pack, but I would read the ingredients at home and most likely stop there.
objection: Nothing here tells me what is actually in the pouch or who makes it. 'No pork ingredients' and cartoon cats are not an ingredient list, and a price this low makes me think it is mostly jelly and filler.
would_change_my_mind: My own vet or the pet shop I already use recommending it, with a full ingredient and nutrition panel I can read on the pack showing real meat as the first ingredient.
